meta.title: Controlled approach on a geostationary neighbour
meta.authored_by: Claude Opus (illustrative draft, pending Ash authoring)
meta.change_reason: ILLUSTRATIVE content authored to exercise the drill loop, the scoring engine and the interface end to end. Derived only from public open-source material on space domain awareness practice, per the flight plan's public-sources rule. It is NOT a JCO procedure and has not been authored or validated by a subject-matter expert. Ash owns authoring and redaction sign-off; every step, threshold and answer key here is TBC, re-verify.

briefing: Two geostationary objects are closing. Establish whether the approach is controlled, characterise the relative geometry, and run the response.
expected_response: Establish relative motion in the along-track, cross-track and radial frame.
Determine whether relative motion is bounded.
Estimate time and distance at closest approach with an uncertainty band.
Classify the approach, using indeterminate where the evidence does not support more.
Increase observation tasking while the geometry is still changing.
